contract: VISUAL_AUDIT.md; latest rounded-button request and client-confirmed project photography supersede earlier directions.

accessibility.evidence: Full-page, all nine project dialogs, and mobile menu axe scans: zero violations at eight viewports. Keyboard focus wrap, Escape/return, form errors and ARIA references pass. See validation/results.json.

responsive.evidence: All eight target sizes have matching screenshots and document scrollWidth equals viewport width. Desktop, tablet and narrow-phone compositions inspected; 1024px hero proportions refined.

loading.evidence: Images reserve fill/aspect-ratio geometry; visible images complete with naturalWidth > 0 in validation/extras.json. Content remains visible during GSAP entrance.

empty.reason: Static nine-record portfolio and fixed categories; each available filter has records. No remote empty-results state.

error.evidence: Empty required input and invalid phone focus the failing field; simulated popup blocking reports recovery instructions and retains entered data.

partial.evidence: M9 location-only image retains disclosure, credit, license and uncropped presentation; uncertain locations remain labeled and details retain role notes.

success.evidence: Intercepted window.open receives correctly encoded WhatsApp draft with verified number. Feedback says review and press Send; no delivery success or actual sending asserted.

permission.reason: No visitor authentication or permission workflow. Photo usage authorization was explicitly confirmed by the user and recorded in project documentation.

renderedEvidence.observation: Final production render: light palette, rounded controls, responsive section layout; no document overflow. Corresponding interaction and axe results in validation/results.json.
